children: Delhi University’s AVASAR 2026 placement drive will bring over 85 organisations and 4,000 registered students together, offering access to jobs and internships across sectors.
The University of Delhi is set to organise the second edition of its placement drive, AVASAR 2026, on October 7, offering students access to employment and internship opportunities across sectors.
Organised by the Central Placement Cell (CPC) under the Office of the Dean of Students’ Welfare, the drive will be held at the Multipurpose Hall in North Campus from 9 am to 5 pm.
Students To Access Jobs And Internships Across Sectors
More than 4,000 students have already registered for the placement drive, which will be open to all Delhi University students. More than 85 organisations are expected to participate.

The participating organisations span areas including education, financial services, technology, social impact and other professional domains. Organisations expected at the event include SPRIX Japan, Teach for India, Kotak Life, PPG Foundation, Cambridge School, Muthoot Finance, Intellexia Tech and Hazelnut Cyborg Infra Solutions, among others.
Salaries And Internship Stipends On Offer
According to the university, the highest annual salary package being offered through the drive exceeds Rs 10 lakh. The highest internship stipend is expected to reach Rs 60,000 per month.
The placement event, earlier known as the “Job Mela”, is aimed at connecting students directly with prospective employers and expanding access to jobs and internships.

The initiative is part of the CPC’s efforts to strengthen engagement between Delhi University and employers. The drive will also give students an opportunity to interact with organisations and explore career options based on their academic qualifications and skill sets.
